code:
-- up to a parent: dot notation
SELECT Name, Account.Name, Owner.Name
FROM Opportunity

-- down to children: subquery
SELECT Name,
  (SELECT Name, Amount
   FROM Opportunities)
FROM Account

code:
-- converted, but no opportunity
SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM Lead
WHERE IsConverted = true
AND ConvertedOpportunityId = null

-- opps with no contact role
SELECT Id FROM Opportunity
WHERE Id NOT IN (SELECT OpportunityId
  FROM OpportunityContactRole)
